{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Long-sleeved athletic top, relaxed fit, hip length, #d1ab86, moisture-wicking synthetic blend.
High-waisted yoga trousers, tapered cut to ankle, #e0bd9a, soft stretch cotton jersey.
Minimalist running sandals, open toe design, #745a3b, breathable mesh upper with contoured footbed.
This outfit works because it prioritizes the freedom of movement required for a morning yoga session while keeping you warm enough for autumn daylight without overheating. The color palette harmonizes with your skin tone and hair, creating a cohesive look that feels intentional yet effortless. All pieces are chosen to support active stretching and balance, ensuring comfort from arrival to the final pose."}
